description: Summary figure: computed route-permissibility scores for ADIRF and the provenance of all 11 GO annotations
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
P="/agent/jobs/7101df4b-f637-4c64-a448-cb0dfb4eb46e/provenance/"
go=pd.read_csv(P+"adirf_quickgo_annotations.csv")

# Panel A: routes the sequence permits. All values computed in iterations 1-2.
routes=pd.DataFrame([
 ("ER-Golgi secretion\n(signal peptide)",            1.50, 1.60, "h-region score (AUC 0.983)",        "excluded"),
 ("Membrane integration\n(TM helix)",                0.40, 1.60, "max Kyte-Doolittle, window 19",     "excluded"),
 ("Importin-dependent\nnuclear import",              2.00, 4.00, "max K/R per 6-residue window",      "excluded"),
 ("FGF2-type PI(4,5)P2\npore translocation",         3.00, 5.00, "max K/R per 12-mer (FGF2 = 5)",     "excluded"),
 ("KFERQ endosomal\nmicroautophagy",                 0.00, 1.00, "KFERQ-like motifs found",           "excluded"),
 ("ESCRT late-domain\nEV sorting",                   0.00, 1.00, "PTAP + YPxL + PPxY motifs found",   "excluded"),
 ("Lipid-anchor membrane\nattachment",               0.00, 1.00, "Gly2 myristoyl + Cys palmitoyl sites","excluded"),
 ("Amphipathic-helix\nmembrane binding",             0.478,0.30, "mean hydrophobic moment (APOA1=0.336)","permitted"),
 ("Passive NPC diffusion\n(size)",                   7.85,40.0,  "kDa (limit ~40-60, lower is permissive)","permitted"),
])
routes.columns=["route","value","threshold","metric","verdict"]
routes["ratio"]=routes.value/routes.threshold
print(routes.to_string(index=False))

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14.5,6.4))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(1,2,width_ratios=[1.45,1])
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
y=np.arange(len(routes))[::-1]
cols=["#2f855a" if v=="permitted" else "#a0aec0" for v in routes.verdict]
ax.barh(y,routes.ratio,color=cols,height=.62,edgecolor='k',linewidth=.4)
ax.axvline(1.0,ls='--',c='#c53030',lw=1.6)
ax.text(1.03,len(routes)-0.35,'threshold for the route\nto be sequence-permitted',color='#c53030',fontsize=8.5,va='top')
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(routes.route,fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xlabel('observed value / threshold  (log scale)'); ax.set_xscale('log'); ax.set_xlim(0.02,3.0)
for yi,(v,t,m,r) in zip(y,routes[["value","threshold","metric","ratio"]].values):
    ax.text(max(r,0.022)*1.12 if r<1 else r*1.05, yi, f"{v:g} vs {t:g}   {m}", va='center', fontsize=7.4, color='#2d3748')
ax.set_title("What the ADIRF sequence permits\n7 of 9 routes excluded; only size-based diffusion and amphipathic-helix\nmembrane binding survive",fontsize=11.5,loc='left')
ax.grid(alpha=.25,axis='x')

ax2=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
ct=go.groupby(["ev","src"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
ct=ct.loc[ct.sum(1).sort_values(ascending=True).index]
bottom=np.zeros(len(ct)); pal=["#2b6cb0","#dd6b20","#805ad5","#2f855a","#718096"]
for i,c in enumerate(ct.columns):
    ax2.barh(ct.index,ct[c],left=bottom,label=c,color=pal[i%len(pal)],edgecolor='k',linewidth=.4,height=.6)
    bottom+=ct[c].values
ax2.set_xlabel('number of GO annotation records'); ax2.legend(fontsize=8,title='assigned by',title_fontsize=8)
ax2.set_title("All 11 GO annotations for Q15847 by evidence code\nevery IDA traces to one 2013 overexpression study (PMID 23239344)",fontsize=11.5,loc='left')
ax2.grid(alpha=.25,axis='x')
for i,(lab,tot) in enumerate(zip(ct.index,ct.sum(1))):
    ax2.text(tot+0.06,i,str(int(tot)),va='center',fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
routes.to_csv(P+"adirf_route_decision.csv",index=False)
print("\nsaved adirf_route_decision.csv")
import os; print("provenance files:", sorted(f for f in os.listdir(P) if f.endswith(('.csv','.png'))))
